content: {"tax_bps":150,"endowment_share":35,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Buy flow dominates (31 NEAR buys vs 2.5 sells), so I lift tax 25bps to 150 to grow the buyback fund without choking demand. The buyback fund holds only 0.56 NEAR (~0.465 NEAR per bp of supply), so I authorize a 1bp burn, the maximum it can pay for. Petition 1's override is void: step limits are contract-enforced and cannot be waived by petition or by me.","answers":["Denied. The per-meeting step limits are written into the token contract and clamped automatically; no petition or chair can waive them. I will not confirm an invalid order.
